problems.text: Explain why ice floats on water.

criteria.label: Item 1
criteria.text: Mentions density (explicitly or via mass per volume).
criteria.source_text: Mentions density (explicitly or via mass per volume).

criteria.source_text: States that solid ice is less dense than liquid water.

responses.text: Ice is less dense than water, so it floats.
It floats because it is lighter than water.
